source.title: 2024 Update to the 2020 ACC/AHA Clinical Performance and Quality Measures for Adults With Heart Failure: A Report of the American Heart Association/American College of Cardiology Joint Committee on Performance Measures

findings: The abstract and Appendix A classify the monoclonal-protein-screen measure as quality measure QM-6, while Top 10 Take-Home Message 10 calls it a performance measure. The atom follows the Appendix A operational specification and carries a source_classification_conflict tag.

Top 10 Take-Home Message 5 says all measures exclude patients after heart transplantation or LVAD placement, but Appendix A lists no such exclusions for QM-2, QM-3, or QM-6. The SEA artifact treats each Appendix A specification as the operational source and preserves this front-matter inconsistency.

schema_gaps: The recovered LiteratureAtom pattern has no dedicated performance_measure or quality_measure atom kind. The nine formal measure specifications are serialized as atom_kind="other" with measure-type and identifier tags.

The recovered atom shape has no typed measure-specification object for numerator, denominator, exclusions, exceptions, setting, and measurement period. Those elements are preserved in canonical statements and tags.
The publication is a secondary clinical policy measure document. Trial effects summarized in its rationales were not promoted to primary-study LiteratureAtoms.

validation_boundary: The authoritative ATOM Pydantic model, atom-kind sufficiency validator, serialization schema, and exact SEA v4 protocol were not directly retrievable. This run therefore uses a strict local Pydantic contract and generated JSON Schema reconstructed from current validated project output patterns, plus local sufficiency checks for the generic atom kinds used here. It does not claim execution of unavailable authoritative project code or the exact SEA v4 scoring rubric.
extraction_limitations: All atoms remain needs_review because no human source-verification step is represented.
The source is a measure-specification update, not a primary empirical study. Its cited trials and observational studies remain secondary evidence.
Appendix B and Appendix C relationship tables were reviewed for governance appraisal but were not atomized person by person.
No external current-practice verification was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
